data_budget.counted_once: one training/discovery/certification log triple per complete trial ID; never times arms, levels or family size
data_budget.in_sample_accounting: in_sample_auditing reuses certification labels for search and point decisions; it does not receive another independent certification sample
data_budget.interpretation: allocated counts include failed trial IDs; generated/exposed counts are only reported or raw-debug-verified data, with unknowns retained
data_budget.limit: saved aggregate data provenance cannot independently prove which arrays every engine consumed

model_reconstruction_scope: supported frozen model and fixed-X source hashes

supplementary_endpoint_definitions.baseline_return: reported separately; baseline utility noninferiority is not a policy-repair improvement
supplementary_endpoint_definitions.return_and_strict_positive_utility_gain: returned policy true utility is strictly greater than policy0, regardless of safety
supplementary_endpoint_definitions.return_nonbaseline_and_safe_and_useful: returned policy differs from policy0 AND satisfies all true primary risk, utility-NI and service/capacity conditions

uncertainty: pointwise Wilson95 per fixed cell/arm/level with complete independent trial denominator; unknown rates/intervals are null
verification_limits: reconstructs saved learned policies/conditional targets for the supported fixed model; does not refit nuisances or replay any random source
checks saved endpoints, decisions and feasibility; does not recompute interval arithmetic, prove assumptions from schema, or validate every saved observation
data accounting uses saved per-trial row/exposure metadata, checked against raw debug where available; no multiplication by arms, levels or candidates
supplementary posthoc repair/strict-gain endpoints do not replace frozen primary outcomes or turn Monte Carlo intervals into certificate guarantees
